description: Tombs of Terror bosses A (phase 8 family 19): eighteen encounters of Saviors of Uldum's Tombs of Terror (ULDA_BOSS_01 to ULDA_BOSS_18: Waste Wanderer Cardish, Dark Ritualist Zafarr, Vera Ridley, Nash the Greatworm, Glack the Scorpid, Mister Chu, Squeamlish, Sinkhole, Demolisher 3V-11, Terraviss, R.O.B.O.L.D., Pyramad, Snakeflinger Scalesnout, Sword Dancer Sirinell, Lt. Herring, Battrund, Ichabod the Cursed, Twizzleflux) and Sinkhole's Sand Trap (ULDA_030). Boss deck lists are transcribed from hearthstone.wiki.gg boss pages (read 2026-11-14), by card name; tools/dungeon-run-catalog (step 'encounters') resolves the names against facts/violet-hold-2026-09.json, checks every card and writes data/dungeon-run/encounters-v1.json. Every Tombs boss hero prints 10 Health: Health is the act curve's, and the tier is the boss's level band read from its page's deck table (levels 1-2: tier 1; 2-3 and 3-4: tier 2; 5-6: tier 3; 7: tier 4; verify/tools/gen/p8f19/tombs_tiers.py).
method: The wiki's MediaWiki API was read for each page twice: the wikitext (action=parse, prop=wikitext) and the rendered deck table (prop=text, rowspans and colspans expanded); the two agree. Each Normal table is transcribed in table order with its own counts (25 or 30 cards); a table of possible cards without counts ("10; 15", "15; 20") is transcribed with count null. Where the Normal list is shorter than 30 the Heroic table is transcribed too and is the row's extend list. A page's level note ("These decks correspond only to level N") and its chapter line are recorded in the row's schedule adaptation. Mister Chu's Mirage Blade is the Bazaar Burglary token ULD_326t (the page's special card); Sinkhole's special card is Sand Trap (ULDA_030). The file is written by verify/tools/gen/p8f19/make_f19.py.

adaptations.note: Tombs boss heroes print 10 Health (the adventure set a boss's Health by level server-side): the fight's Health is the act curve's and the tier is the boss's level in its chapter, from its wiki page's deck table: level 7 (a full 30-card list with no smaller lower-level version, the shape of a chapter's seventh boss, the last before its Plague Lord) = tier 4. The page names chapter 2 as the chapter the boss is first met in (after it, any completed chapter), which does not set its level.

Listed cards the engine does not script yet are replaced by a scripted card of the same role, named in the row's replacements (the encounters step records each one): Hunter's Pack (it can give the boss a random Hunter Secret; this row generates none) by Animal Companion, Injured Tol'vir by Frostwolf Grunt, Kobold Sandtrooper by Leper Gnome (the same Deathrattle, 2 damage), Sunstruck Henchman by Chillwind Yeti.

Sand Surge (1) shuffles one Sand Trap (ULDA_030, the page's special card) into the run player's deck as a public shuffle (the run player sees it go in; the boss's fair view keeps that deck masked, the Sand Trap included). Sand Trap: Casts When Drawn, the top 2 cards of its holder's deck go to the graveyard (public, as Azari's Devour), then the holder draws a card. It is a match card only: the run deck records never hold it. Offered while the run player's deck has room.
